question: Who among the following is the author of the Hindi novel ‘Raag Darbari’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shrilal Shukla**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shrilal Shukla** is the author of the Hindi novel 'Raag Darbari'.
 
• 'Raag Darbari' is considered one of the most significant works in modern Hindi literature.
 
• The novel offers a satirical look at the social and political conditions in rural India.
 
• Shrilal Shukla was awarded the Sahitya Akademi Award for this novel in 1969.
 
• The book has been translated into multiple languages and remains a critical piece of literature in academic studies.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Shrilal Shukla** (1925-2011) was an Indian author and a prominent figure in Hindi literature.
 
• He was known for his sharp wit and keen observation of social issues.
 
• His other notable works include 'Makkhan Chor' and 'Sooni Ghaati Ka Sooraj'.
 
• He was also awarded the Jnanpith Award in 2009 for his contribution to Indian literature.
 
• 'Raag Darbari' has been adapted into a television series, further cementing its place in popular culture.
